binary_matrix_sanity_rule.trigger: long 0/1 digit runs occur in OCR text
positive_criteria: at least 4 binary tokens, each at least 18 digits
modal binary-token length is at least 18 and modal-length regularity is at least 0.75
binary-token character ratio is at least 0.45
at least 2 deterministic source-code or matrix context markers are present
candidate tokens are not all single-symbol runs and not all alternating runs
negative_criteria: a single-symbol run of at least 18 digits without positive matrix evidence
an alternating 0/1 run of at least 18 digits without positive matrix evidence
fewer than 4 regular binary tokens, insufficient binary-token ratio, missing 0/1 diversity, or insufficient context
binary_matrix_sanity_rule.false_positive_protection: Numeric runs are accepted only when the complete deterministic matrix evidence predicate passes; repeated-symbol and alternating-noise fixtures remain rejected.

extractor_selection_rules: otherwise OCR when visual text is present
verified blank only with visual evidence
ocr_routing_for_corrupt_text_layer: page scoped at 150 DPI using frozen local tesseract.js runtime
body_quality_rules: content sanity requires all authoritative page text and the normalized body to pass text quality
cross_identity_collision_rules: same body hash across distinct source hashes is a hard failure when body quality is low
existing_persistence_revalidation_rules: validate source/body hashes and both new quality gates before reuse
checkpoint_rules: next runner revision must atomically record attempt, phase, and identity completion before aggregation
attempt_result_rules: result must be current for running, pass, partial, blocked, exception, and timeout
child_timeout_rules: record paper id, phase, command kind, duration, exit code, and timeout outcome
evidence_fingerprint_algorithm: uppercase SHA256 over UTF-8 newline-joined path<TAB>file_sha256 records in the exact listed order

child_process_contract.audit_state_validation_rule: exact required schema and global monotonic sequence
child_process_contract.ocr_invocation_scope: one child invocation per target page

diagnostic_result: 6/6 pdf-inspector pages CORRUPT_ENCODING; 6/6 Poppler pages LOW_INFORMATION; route requires page-scoped OCR on next complete Pilot
